fact: In a communiqué reported by Inforpress on 6 October 2025, answering the municipalities' association (ANMCV), which said it was indignant at the suspension of NOSi's services to municipalities, NOSi said that all 21 municipalities other than Mosteiros were regularly supplied with its services under local digital-governance service contracts in place since 2022, that the councils' payment rate was very low, and that it bore the telecommunications and other supplier costs of keeping the services running; the text counts councils served by NOSi and does not name the RTPE or say how the offices are connected.
title: NOSi garante “total flexibilidade negocial” junto das câmaras municipais para evitar disrupção dos serviços digitais
